event: Komdigi Minister Meutya Hafid denies that Komdigi removed or requested removal of karhutla content, after celebrities and SAFEnet complained of suspected shadowbanning on Instagram/Threads and a removed TikTok video from Siak's regent.

event: Ookla's Q3 2026 data shows Indonesia's median mobile download speed at 52.01 Mbps, up 43.4% year on year, ranking 5th of 7 in ASEAN, while 5G median speed of 126.48 Mbps ranks 6th of 7.
key_numbers: Mobile median 52,01 Mbps (36,27 Mbps Q3 2025; 24,75 Mbps Q3 2023) · users >=100 Mbps 26% (12%) · 5G median 126,48 Mbps (+55,6%) · 5G availability 34,2% (6,9%) · ASEAN: Singapore 151,89, Malaysia 141,95, Vietnam 126,71, Thailand 110,78, Philippines 50,77 Mbps · 5G rollout concentrated in Jakarta/Java

key_numbers: Coretax contract Rp1,23 triliun · consortium LG CNS + Qualysoft · nationwide use since Jan 2025 · LG CNS in Indonesia since 2006 · claim of stability not independently verified
